effects.name: Berserk

props.animation_script:
// ============================================================================

// Zero Power: Temper Tantrum (Foundry VTT v12)

// Flavor:

// 1) Play a Jill cut-in (styled after Rebellion example)

// 2) At the start of the fire VFX, spawn a pseudo clone of the caster image

//    and make it scale outward + fade out

// 3) Play fire cone VFX on caster using ONI Pseudo Animation

// 4) At the same time, play both SFX with Sequencer

// 5) Tint the caster token red

//

// NOTE:

// - VFX is handled by Pseudo Animation

// - SFX is handled by Sequencer only

// - Red tint is LEFT ON at the end intentionally

// ============================================================================


(async () => {

  const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][ZeroPower][TemperTantrum]";


  // -----------------------------

  // Assets

  // -----------------------------

  const CUTIN_URL =

    "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Campaign/The%20Legend%20of%20Dragonslayer/Image/NPCs/Jill/Jill_Standard.png";


  const FIRE_VFX =

    "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Template/Cone/Breath_Weapon/Breathweapon02_Fire02_Regular_Orange_Cone_Burst_800x800.webm";


const CUTIN_SFX_URL =

  "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/BurstMax.ogg";


const SFX_CAST =

  "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/BerzerkerCaster.wav";


const SFX_EXPLOSION =

  "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Explosion2.ogg";


  // -----------------------------

  // Tunables

  // -----------------------------

const CUTIN = {

  dimAlpha: 0.60,

  dimFadeMs: 180,

  flashPeak: 0.90,

  flashDelayMs: 50,

  flashInMs: 70,

  flashOutMs: 170,

  slideInMs: 650,

  holdMs: 850,

  slideOutMs: 650,

  portraitHeightRatio: 0.90,

  portraitInsetX: 220,

  portraitBottomMargin: 40,

  portraitYOffset: -140,

  sfxVol: 0.90

};


  const VFX = {

    scale: 1,

    offsetX: -15,   // positive = move right, negative = move left

    offsetY: -415, // positive = move down, negative = move up

    rotationDeg: -90,

    fallbackDurationMs: 1800,

    zIndex: 999999

  };


  // New: caster clone burst tuning

  const CLONE_BURST = {

    startScale: 1.00,

    endScale: 10.20,

    startAlpha: 0.95,

    endAlpha: 0.00,

    durationMs: 320,

    zIndexOffset: -1 // relative to fire VFX zIndex

  };


  const RED_TINT_HEX = 0xff3b30;


  // -----------------------------

  // Helpers

  // -----------------------------

  const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, ms)));


  globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

  if (!ONI.emit) {

    ONI.emit = (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) => {

      const { local = true, world = false } = options;

      if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

      if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

    };

  }


  function resolveCasterTokenSync() {

    const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

    const uuid =

      p.casterTokenUuid ||

      p.attackerTokenUuid ||

      p.attacker_token_uuid ||

      p.attackerTokenUUID ||

      p.sourceTokenUuid ||

      p.source_token_uuid ||

      null;


    if (uuid && typeof fromUuidSync === "function") {

      const doc = fromUuidSync(uuid);

      const token = doc?.object ?? null;

      if (token) return token;

    }


    return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

  }


  async function resolveCasterTokenAsync() {

    const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

    const uuid =

      p.casterTokenUuid ||

      p.attackerTokenUuid ||

      p.attacker_token_uuid ||

      p.attackerTokenUUID ||

      p.sourceTokenUuid ||

      p.source_token_uuid ||

      null;


    if (uuid) {

      try {

        const doc = await fromUuid(uuid);

        return doc?.object ?? null;

      } catch (_) {}

    }


    return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

  }


  let sourceToken = null;

  let runId = null;


  try {

    if (!canvas?.ready) {

      ui.notifications.warn("Canvas is not ready yet.");

      return;

    }


    if (!game?.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

      ui.notifications.error("ONI Pseudo Animation API not found: game.ONI.pseudo.play");

      return;

    }


    if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

      ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

      return;

    }


    sourceToken = resolveCasterTokenSync() ?? (await resolveCasterTokenAsync());


    if (!sourceToken) {

      ui.notifications.warn("No caster token found. Select a token or provide __PAYLOAD caster uuid.");

      return;

    }


    runId = `${Date.now()}-${foundry.utils.randomID(6)}`;


    console.log(TAG, "START", {

      runId,

      caster: {

        id: sourceToken.id,

        name: sourceToken.name,

        uuid: sourceToken.document.uuid

      }

    });


    ONI.emit(

      "oni:animationStart",

      {

        type: "zeroPower.temperTantrum",

        runId,

        sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

        sourceTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

        sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

        timestamp: Date.now()

      },

      { local: true, world: false }

    );


    // =========================================================================

    // PHASE A — Cut-in overlay (Pseudo Broadcast)

    // =========================================================================

    const phaseA = `

const TAG = "[ONI][Pseudo][TemperTantrum][PhaseA]";

const { params } = ctx;


if (!canvas?.ready) throw new Error("Canvas not ready");


const wait = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, ms)));


const CUTIN_URL = String(params.cutinUrl);

const CUTIN_SFX_URL = String(params.cutinSfxUrl ?? "");

const cfg = params.cutinCfg ?? {};


const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

const easeInCubic = (t) => t * t * t;

const easeOutQuad = (t) => 1 - (1 - t) * (1 - t);

const easeInQuad = (t) => t * t;


function tween(obj, prop, from, to, ms, ease = easeOutQuad) {

  return new Promise((resolve) => {

    const dur = Math.max(1, Number(ms) || 1);

    const start = performance.now();

    obj[prop] = from;


    const step = (now) => {

      const t = Math.min(1, (now - start) / dur);

      obj[prop] = from + (to - from) * ease(t);

      if (t < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);

      else resolve();

    };


    requestAnimationFrame(step);

  });

}


function tweenXY(obj, xFrom, xTo, yFrom, yTo, ms, ease = easeOutQuad) {

  return new Promise((resolve) => {

    const dur = Math.max(1, Number(ms) || 1);

    const start = performance.now();

    obj.x = xFrom;

    obj.y = yFrom;


    const step = (now) => {

      const t = Math.min(1, (now - start) / dur);

      const k = ease(t);

      obj.x = xFrom + (xTo - xFrom) * k;

      obj.y = yFrom + (yTo - yFrom) * k;

      if (t < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);

      else resolve();

    };


    requestAnimationFrame(step);

  });

}


function tweenCombo(items) {

  return new Promise((resolve) => {

    const start = performance.now();

    for (const it of items) it.obj[it.prop] = it.from;


    const step = (now) => {

      let done = true;


      for (const it of items) {

        const ms = Math.max(1, Number(it.ms) || 1);

        const t = Math.min(1, (now - start) / ms);

        const k = (it.ease || easeOutQuad)(t);

        it.obj[it.prop] = it.from + (it.to - it.from) * k;

        if (t < 1) done = false;

      }


      if (!done) requestAnimationFrame(step);

      else resolve();

    };


    requestAnimationFrame(step);

  });

}


async function loadTextureSafe(src) {

  const fn = foundry?.utils?.preloadTexture ?? globalThis.loadTexture;

  if (typeof fn === "function") return await fn(src);

  if (PIXI?.Assets?.load) return await PIXI.Assets.load(src);

  return PIXI.Texture.from(src);

}


async function playSfx(url, volume = 0.9) {

  if (!url) return;


  try {

    if (globalThis.AudioHelper?.play) {

      await AudioHelper.play({ src: url, volume, autoplay: true, loop: false }, true);

      return;

    }

  } catch (e) {

    console.warn(TAG, "AudioHelper.play failed, falling back:", e);

  }


  try {

    const a = new Audio(url);

    a.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volume));

    await a.play();

  } catch (e) {

    console.warn(TAG, "HTMLAudio play failed:", e);

  }

}


let overlay = null;


try {

  const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

  const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;


  overlay = new PIXI.Container();

  overlay.zIndex = 999999;

  canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

  canvas.stage.addChild(overlay);

  canvas.stage.sortChildren();


  const dim = new PIXI.Graphics();

  dim.beginFill(0x000000, 1).drawRect(0, 0, W, H).endFill();

  dim.alpha = 0;


  const flash = new PIXI.Graphics();

  flash.beginFill(0xffffff, 1).drawRect(0, 0, W, H).endFill();

  flash.alpha = 0;


  overlay.addChild(dim, flash);


  await tween(dim, "alpha", 0, Number(cfg.dimAlpha ?? 0.6), Number(cfg.dimFadeMs ?? 180), easeOutQuad);


  const tex = await loadTextureSafe(CUTIN_URL);

  const texture = tex instanceof PIXI.Texture ? tex : PIXI.Texture.from(CUTIN_URL);


  const portrait = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

  portrait.anchor.set(0, 1);

  overlay.addChild(portrait);


  const targetH = H * Number(cfg.portraitHeightRatio ?? 0.9);

  const scale = targetH / portrait.texture.height;

  portrait.scale.set(scale);


  const finalX = Number(cfg.portraitInsetX ?? 220);

  const finalY =

    (H - Number(cfg.portraitBottomMargin ?? 40)) +

    Number(cfg.portraitYOffset ?? -140);


  const startX = -portrait.width - 80;

  portrait.x = startX;

  portrait.y = finalY;

  portrait.alpha = 1;


  await wait(Number(cfg.flashDelayMs ?? 50));


await tween(flash, "alpha", 0, Number(cfg.flashPeak ?? 0.9), Number(cfg.flashInMs ?? 70), easeOutQuad);

const flashFadePromise = tween(flash, "alpha", flash.alpha, 0, Number(cfg.flashOutMs ?? 170), easeInQuad);


playSfx(CUTIN_SFX_URL, Number(cfg.sfxVol ?? 0.9)).catch(() => {});


await tweenXY(

  portrait,

  portrait.x,

  finalX,

  portrait.y,

  finalY,

  Number(cfg.slideInMs ?? 650),

  easeOutCubic

);


  await flashFadePromise;

  await wait(Number(cfg.holdMs ?? 850));


  const exitX = W + 40;


  await Promise.all([

    tween(dim, "alpha", dim.alpha, 0, 180, easeInQuad),

    tweenCombo([

      {

        obj: portrait,

        prop: "x",

        from: portrait.x,

        to: exitX,

        ms: Number(cfg.slideOutMs ?? 650),

        ease: easeInCubic

      },

      {

        obj: portrait,

        prop: "alpha",

        from: 1,

        to: 0,

        ms: Number(cfg.slideOutMs ?? 650),

        ease: easeInQuad

      }

    ])

  ]);


  console.log(TAG, "Cut-in done");

} catch (err) {

  console.warn(TAG, "Cut-in failed (non-fatal):", err);

} finally {

  try {

    if (overlay) overlay.destroy({ children: true, texture: false, baseTexture: false });

  } catch (_) {}

}

`;


const phaseAResult = game.ONI.pseudo.play({

  scriptId: "zeroPower.temperTantrum.phaseA",

  scriptSource: phaseA,

  casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

  targetTokenUuids: [],

  params: {

    cutinUrl: CUTIN_URL,

    cutinSfxUrl: CUTIN_SFX_URL,

    cutinCfg: CUTIN

  },

  meta: { source: "Zero Power: Temper Tantrum (Phase A Cut-In)" }

});


    if (phaseAResult && typeof phaseAResult.then === "function") {

      await phaseAResult;

    } else {

      await wait(CUTIN.slideInMs + CUTIN.holdMs + CUTIN.slideOutMs + 250);

    }


    // =========================================================================

    // PHASE B — Caster Clone Burst + Fire VFX (Pseudo) + 2 SFX (Sequencer) + Red Tint

    // =========================================================================


    const sfxPromise = new Sequence()

      .sound()

      .file(SFX_CAST)

      .volume(0.90)

      .sound()

      .file(SFX_EXPLOSION)

      .volume(0.90)

      .play();


    const phaseB = `

const TAG = "[ONI][Pseudo][TemperTantrum][PhaseB]";

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;


if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Need casterToken");

if (!canvas?.ready) throw new Error("Canvas not ready");


const wait = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, ms)));


const VFX_FILE = String(params.vfxFile);

const SCALE = Number(params.scale ?? 2);

const OFFSET_X = Number(params.offsetX ?? 0);

const OFFSET_Y = Number(params.offsetY ?? 0);

const ROT_DEG = Number(params.rotationDeg ?? -90);

const DURATION_MS = Number(params.durationMs ?? 1800);

const Z_INDEX = Number(params.zIndex ?? 999999);

const RED_TINT = Number(params.redTint ?? 0xff3b30);


const CLONE_START_SCALE = Number(params.cloneStartScale ?? 1.0);

const CLONE_END_SCALE = Number(params.cloneEndScale ?? 2.2);

const CLONE_START_ALPHA = Number(params.cloneStartAlpha ?? 0.95);

const CLONE_END_ALPHA = Number(params.cloneEndAlpha ?? 0.0);

const CLONE_DURATION_MS = Number(params.cloneDurationMs ?? 320);

const CLONE_Z_OFFSET = Number(params.cloneZOffset ?? -1);


function clamp01(x) {

  return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, x));

}


function easeOutCubic(t) {

  return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

}


async function safeLoadTexture(src) {

  try {

    const fn = foundry?.utils?.preloadTexture ?? globalThis.loadTexture;

    if (typeof fn === "function") {

      const t = await fn(src);

      return t instanceof PIXI.Texture ? t : PIXI.Texture.from(src);

    }

  } catch (_) {}


  try {

    if (PIXI?.Assets?.load) {

      const t = await PIXI.Assets.load(src);

      return t instanceof PIXI.Texture ? t : PIXI.Texture.from(src);

    }

  } catch (_) {}


  return PIXI.Texture.from(src);

}


function animateProps(items, durMs, easeFn = easeOutCubic) {

  return new Promise((resolve) => {

    const dur = Math.max(1, Number(durMs) || 1);

    const start = performance.now();


    for (const it of items) {

      it.obj[it.prop] = it.from;

    }


    const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;


    const update = () => {

      const raw = (performance.now() - start) / dur;

      const t = clamp01(raw);

      const k = easeFn(t);


      for (const it of items) {

        it.obj[it.prop] = it.from + (it.to - it.from) * k;

      }


      if (t >= 1) {

        ticker.remove(update);

        resolve();

      }

    };


    ticker.add(update);

  });

}


async function ensureVideoPlays(texture) {

  try {

    const res = texture?.baseTexture?.resource;

    const vid = res?.source;


    if (vid instanceof HTMLVideoElement) {

      vid.loop = false;

      vid.muted = true;

      vid.playsInline = true;

      await vid.play().catch(() => {});

      return vid;

    }


    if (typeof res?.play === "function") res.play();

  } catch (e) {

    console.warn(TAG, "ensureVideoPlays failed:", e);

  }


  return null;

}


async function getVideoDurationMs(texture, fallbackMs) {

  try {

    const res = texture?.baseTexture?.resource;

    const vid = res?.source;


    if (vid instanceof HTMLVideoElement) {

      const dur = Number(vid.duration);

      if (Number.isFinite(dur) && dur > 0) return Math.round(dur * 1000);

    }

  } catch (_) {}


  return fallbackMs;

}


async function createCasterClone(token, zIndex) {

  const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

  const tex = baseObj?.texture ?? await safeLoadTexture(token.document.texture.src);


  const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

  sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

  sprite.x = token.center.x;

  sprite.y = token.center.y;

  sprite.zIndex = zIndex;

  sprite.alpha = CLONE_START_ALPHA;


  if (baseObj) {

    sprite.width = baseObj.width;

    sprite.height = baseObj.height;

    sprite.angle = baseObj.angle ?? 0;

  }


  const flipX = (baseObj?.scale?.x ?? 1) < 0 ? -1 : 1;

  const flipY = (baseObj?.scale?.y ?? 1) < 0 ? -1 : 1;


  sprite.scale.set(

    Math.abs(sprite.scale.x || 1) * flipX * CLONE_START_SCALE,

    Math.abs(sprite.scale.y || 1) * flipY * CLONE_START_SCALE

  );


  canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

  canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

  canvas.stage.sortChildren();


  return sprite;

}


let fireSprite = null;

let cloneSprite = null;


try {

  const texture = await safeLoadTexture(VFX_FILE);


  fireSprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

  fireSprite.anchor.set(0.5);

  fireSprite.x = casterToken.center.x + OFFSET_X;

  fireSprite.y = casterToken.center.y + OFFSET_Y;

  fireSprite.scale.set(SCALE);

  fireSprite.rotation = (ROT_DEG * Math.PI) / 180;

  fireSprite.zIndex = Z_INDEX;


  canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

  canvas.stage.addChild(fireSprite);

  canvas.stage.sortChildren();


  // Clone burst happens at the START of the fire VFX

  cloneSprite = await createCasterClone(casterToken, Z_INDEX + CLONE_Z_OFFSET);


  await ensureVideoPlays(texture);


  // Tint the real caster token red on every client

  const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

  if (baseMesh) {

    baseMesh.tint = RED_TINT;

  }


  const cloneBaseScaleX = cloneSprite.scale.x;

  const cloneBaseScaleY = cloneSprite.scale.y;


  const cloneBurstPromise = (async () => {

    await animateProps(

      [

        {

          obj: cloneSprite.scale,

          prop: "x",

          from: cloneBaseScaleX,

          to: cloneBaseScaleX * CLONE_END_SCALE

        },

        {

          obj: cloneSprite.scale,

          prop: "y",

          from: cloneBaseScaleY,

          to: cloneBaseScaleY * CLONE_END_SCALE

        },

        {

          obj: cloneSprite,

          prop: "alpha",

          from: CLONE_START_ALPHA,

          to: CLONE_END_ALPHA

        }

      ],

      CLONE_DURATION_MS,

      easeOutCubic

    );


    try {

      if (cloneSprite) {

        canvas.stage.removeChild(cloneSprite);

        cloneSprite.destroy();

        cloneSprite = null;

      }

    } catch (_) {}

  })();


  const realDuration = await getVideoDurationMs(texture, DURATION_MS);


  await Promise.allSettled([

    cloneBurstPromise,

    wait(realDuration)

  ]);


  console.log(TAG, "VFX done");

} catch (err) {

  console.error(TAG, "PhaseB failed:", err);

  throw err;

} finally {

  try {

    if (cloneSprite) {

      canvas.stage.removeChild(cloneSprite);

      cloneSprite.destroy();

      cloneSprite = null;

    }

  } catch (_) {}


  try {

    if (fireSprite) {

      canvas.stage.removeChild(fireSprite);

      fireSprite.destroy();

      fireSprite = null;

    }

  } catch (_) {}

}

`;


    const phaseBResult = game.ONI.pseudo.play({

      scriptId: "zeroPower.temperTantrum.phaseB",

      scriptSource: phaseB,

      casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

      targetTokenUuids: [],

      params: {

        vfxFile: FIRE_VFX,

        scale: VFX.scale,

        offsetX: VFX.offsetX,

        offsetY: VFX.offsetY,

        rotationDeg: VFX.rotationDeg,

        durationMs: VFX.fallbackDurationMs,

        zIndex: VFX.zIndex,

        redTint: RED_TINT_HEX,


        cloneStartScale: CLONE_BURST.startScale,

        cloneEndScale: CLONE_BURST.endScale,

        cloneStartAlpha: CLONE_BURST.startAlpha,

        cloneEndAlpha: CLONE_BURST.endAlpha,

        cloneDurationMs: CLONE_BURST.durationMs,

        cloneZOffset: CLONE_BURST.zIndexOffset

      },

      meta: { source: "Zero Power: Temper Tantrum (Phase B VFX)" }

    });


    await Promise.allSettled([

      sfxPromise,

      phaseBResult && typeof phaseBResult.then === "function"

        ? phaseBResult

        : wait(VFX.fallbackDurationMs)

    ]);


    console.log(TAG, "END");

  } catch (err) {

    console.error(TAG, "CRASHED:", err);

    ui.notifications.error(`Temper Tantrum animation crashed: ${err?.message ?? err}`);

  } finally {

    try {

      ONI.emit(

        "oni:animationEnd",

        {

          type: "zeroPower.temperTantrum",

          runId: runId ?? null,

          sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null,

          sourceTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

          sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

          timestamp: Date.now()

        },

        { local: true, world: false }

      );

    } catch (_) {}

  }

})();
props.description: Inflicts Berserk and Strong to self, then, perform a Free Attack
props.name: Zero Power: Temper Tantrum
